title: Nuclear Construction Is Growing, And Half Centers On China
hook: The nuclear building wave is real, but one country dominates it.
closing: Where nuclear construction happens now will shape who supplies future electricity.
question: Will nuclear construction keep growing?

segments.say: Ten nuclear reactor projects started construction in 2025. The global building pipeline is still moving.
China holds 50% of nuclear capacity under construction. Half of the pipeline is concentrated in one country.
Worldwide nuclear construction totals 78 gigawatts. That concentration sits inside a large global buildout.
